reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: Spec violation confirmed: RPC path (verify_kzg_for_rpc_blocks L415-448) only performs KZG validation, skipping signature/inclusion proof checks that gossip path enforces (validate_data_column_sidecar_for_gossip L474-524). Spec SG-009 INV-004 states 'Sidecars should only be served for blocks passing gossip validation', but this is a SENDER requirement, not receiver validation. The Lighthouse RPC path is intentionally minimal because blocks undergo full validation during import (process_backfill_blocks L593-621). Columns are only cached temporarily; the block header signature and state transition are verified before finalization. An attacker can provide RPC columns with valid KZG but forged signatures, but these blocks will fail import validation, preventing finalization. No persistent state corruption or propagation occurs. This is a spec compliance issue (should reject malformed RPC responses earlier), not an exploitable vulnerability. Severity downgrade: informational optimization opportunity.
reviewed_items.spec_reference: Fulu P2P SG-006 (gossip validation), SG-008/SG-009 (RPC endpoints). Spec requires RPC servers to only serve validated blocks (INV-004), but receiver-side enforcement is defense-in-depth, not mandatory.
